title: TOP SUBMISSIONS EP4 In AUGUST, 2022
htmlContent:
TOP SUBMISSIONS EP4 In AUGUST, 2022. We are still dedicated to showcasing the best tracks from the underground by searching far and wide in order to bring you our weekly list.

It’s a tough job as we sift through a ton of high-quality tracks just to settle for just 5 so we switched it up so now we curating the Top Submissions. Now that is what we call dedication, so sit back relax and get familiar with these acts. Remember, don’t forget to support them by sharing their works.

Mykii J and Mimi A.K.A. The Kelly - BOUNCE

Release By: MC2 Entertainment
Release Date: 31 August, 2022

Mykii J releases a brand new track called "BOUNCE" featuring Mimi A.K.A. The Kelly. This single "BOUNCE," is a massively energetic, fun, and infectious record with the potential to be a smash hit. It’s a record you can hear in any part of the world, with a mainstream sound that is complimented by impressive songwriting that makes it relatable for the masses. The vocals are perfect with mastery in the emotion it conveys to serve as the perfect guide, over this amazing production that sets the perfect stage for them to shine.

Warvet Da Rappa - Whore (Nuns)

Release Date: 10 August, 2022

Warvet Da Rappa's "Whore (Nuns)" is everything that makes people connect with music. It’s musical brilliance from the production, singing, and writing that come together in a divine way to create amazing audio for the world to hear.

Sevee & A.Tibbz - Something About It

Release By: Independent Artist
Release Date: 12 August, 2022

Sevee & A.Tibbz's "Something About It" is that music packed with honesty that you can feel. It’s enjoyable in every aspect of music to to make it worth every listen, and filled with great emotion to give it replay value for time to come.

Dtm716 - New Victims (Feat. Young Buck)

Release By: Ovanight Music
Release Date: 06 August, 2022

Dtm716 and Young Buck's "New Victims" is everything that makes people buy into an artist and their work. He’s impressive in every aspect of his craft, while also making entertaining music and visuals that creates an experience for the listener to enjoy majorly.

Rayoe - Extra

Release By: Kremlin Regime
Release Date: 16 August, 2022

Rayoe shares a new single called "Extra," a musical work of art, that feels good to the soul to listen to. The writing shines to the fullest and shows his ability to bring a concept to life to make work of art for people everywhere.

CamWORLDTOUR - NEW PATH

Release By: Hartwell Records
Release Date: 30 August, 2022

CamWORLDTOUR's "NEW PATH" is an incredible display of Hip Hop you must not go another day without hearing. He demonstrates excellence in every aspect of his game. From the exciting flow that takes you on a wild ride of excitement, hard lyrics that get you out your seat, and all delivered masterfully to makes this track a gem that shines majorly.
